packs.name: Kenney Mini Characters 1
packs.license_evidence_url: https://kenney.nl/assets/mini-characters (page: 'CC0 licensed!'); also /Users/justinking/dev/amux/macos/Assets/src/kenney-mini-characters/License.txt ('License: (Creative Commons Zero, CC0)')
packs.recolourable: Two skinned meshes per character: 'body-mesh' and 'head-mesh', both on one 'colormap' material (small palette texture). Recolour by swapping body-mesh's material for a flat per-agent colour, or by editing colormap.png per agent. No hood; chunky blocky 'mini' proportions.
packs.notes: Best clip coverage in the lane: 32 clips baked into every character GLB, verified by parsing the JSON chunk. Covers idle, walk, sit, pick-up, emote-yes/no (usable as look-up/react), interact-left/right (usable as typing-at-desk substitute). No typing, stretch, drink or wave. 12 characters (male a-f, female a-f) plus glasses/sunglasses/mask accessories. Rig has 2 skins per file (body + head).

packs.name: KayKit Character Pack: Adventurers 2.0 (Free)
packs.license_evidence_url: https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-adventurers (asset license row: 'Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal'); also /Users/justinking/dev/amux/macos/Assets/src/kaykit-adventurers/KayKit_Adventurers_2.0_FREE/License.txt ('License: (Creative Commons Zero, CC0)')
packs.format: GLB characters + GLB animation rigs (also FBX, glTF+bin props)
packs.recolourable: Rogue_Hooded.glb has separate skinned meshes RogueHooded_Body, RogueHooded_Cape, RogueHooded_Head, RogueHooded_Mask, arms and legs, all on one 'rogue' material with rogue_texture.png atlas. Recolour the hood/torso by giving RogueHooded_Body (+Cape) a flat-colour material per agent, or tint a copy of rogue_texture.png.
packs.notes: The only CC0 pack found with a genuinely HOODED humanoid (Rogue_Hooded, hood + face mask, very Mr. Robot). Character GLBs carry NO animations themselves; clips live in the two Rig_Medium_*.glb mannequin files (same skeleton, retarget by bone name). Free tier has idle/walk/run/interact/pickup/use_item but NO sit, typing, wave or stretch; pair with UAL or KayKit Animations for sitting. Also has Knight, Barbarian, Mage, Ranger, plain Rogue and 25+ prop glTFs. Fantasy styling but Rogue_Hooded is generic enough.

packs.name: Quaternius Ultimate Animated Character Pack (glTF subset)
packs.license_evidence_url: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimatedanimatedcharacter.html (license link to https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/); also License.txt inside the Google Drive folder https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1sNi1AfenfPRrvRt5yfaj5QMMd6KKcUJ5 saved to /Users/justinking/dev/amux/macos/Assets/src/quaternius-ultimate-animated-character/License.txt ('CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0) Public Domain Dedication')
packs.format: glTF 2.0 (embedded base64 buffers, one file per character)
packs.recolourable: Single skinned mesh 'Cube.004' but multiple flat-colour materials: Casual/Worker/Suit variants have 'Shirt' (torso), 'Pants', 'Belt', 'Skin', 'Face', 'Hair' (Worker adds 'Vest','Hat'); Ninja has 'Main' (whole outfit incl. head wrap), 'Details', 'Grey'. Recolour the hoodie/torso by setting the 'Shirt' (or Ninja 'Main') material base colour per agent, no texture editing needed.
packs.notes: 52-model pack on Google Drive (folders Blends/FBX/glTF/OBJ); only 15 hacker-den-relevant characters were pulled (BaseCharacter, Casual x7, Worker x2, Ninja x3, Suit x2), each ~1.7-2.2 MB with 16-17 baked clips verified from the glTF JSON. Has SitDown/StandUp (transition clips, no sitting loop) plus Idle, Walk, PickUp, Victory. No typing, stretch, drink, wave. No hood; Ninja head-wrap is the closest. Flat-shaded, ~1.8 m human proportions. Remaining characters (Chef, Cowboy, Doctor, Elf, Goblin, Kimono, Knight, Pirate, Soldier, Viking, Witch, Wizard, Zombie, Cow, Pug) can be fetched from the same Drive folder listing (embeddedfolderview id 1UNNT0MeVX0O04RGgu8aLkKe3fwB9_t-A).

packs.name: Quaternius Universal Animation Library [Standard]
packs.license_evidence_url: https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library (asset license row: 'Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal'); also /Users/justinking/dev/amux/macos/Assets/src/quaternius-universal-animation-library/Universal Animation Library[Standard]/License.txt ('CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0) Public Domain Dedication')
packs.format: GLB (animated mannequin; _RM variant has root motion)
packs.recolourable: Grey mannequin only ('Mannequin' mesh, materials 'M_Main' and 'M_Joints'); intended as an animation source to retarget onto a real character, not to ship as-is.
packs.notes: Animation library, not a character: 43 clips on a humanoid mannequin, verified from the GLB JSON. This is the only lane source with a true sitting LOOP (Sitting_Idle_Loop, Sitting_Talking_Loop, Sitting_Enter/Exit) and desk-ish actions (PickUp_Table, Fixing_Kneeling, Interact, Idle_Talking_Loop for look-up/react). Same Quaternius skeleton family as the Ultimate Animated Character Pack, so retargeting there is the natural pairing. The Unity FBX duplicates (47 MB) were deleted to keep the lane under budget; GLBs remain. Still no explicit typing, stretch, drink or wave.

Included mainly because it is the only CC0 source found with Wave, Cheer and LayingDownIdle (the mattress idle). 30 clips verified from the GLB JSON. Lowest priority of the five.

rejected: Gobkit Free Minions (gobkit.itch.io/gobkit-free-minions): CC0 and GLB, but page states only idle/attack/dead baked onto a single track; no walk/sit; goblin-like minions, not humanoid hackers. Not downloaded.
plewr '3D Rigged Character' (plewr.itch.io/3d-rigged-character): CC0, downloaded and parsed; characterRIGGED.glb has a skin but zero animations and zero materials (untextured single mesh). Deleted.
OpenGameArt 'Low-poly hooded character [rigged, Blender]': the only hoodie hit in search, but page license is CC-BY-SA 4.0 and it is .blend only. Not downloaded.

Quaternius Universal Base Characters [Standard] (quaternius.itch.io/universal-base-characters): CC0 but a single 122 MB zip, which alone exceeds the ~120 MB lane budget; the UAL mannequin already covers the rig/clips. Not downloaded.

Quaternius Cyberpunk Game Kit / Animated Men / Animated Women / RPG Characters: CC0 on quaternius.com but distributed only via Google Drive folders with FBX/OBJ/Blend (no glTF listed) and their animation sets overlap the Ultimate pack; cyberpunk kit was left to the environment lane (already present at src/quaternius-cyberpunk-game-kit).
KayKit Skeletons / Dungeon Remastered character packs: CC0 but skeleton/monster bodies do not fit a hooded-human hacker crew; Adventurers already provides the Rig_Medium skeleton and hooded Rogue.
Gobkit Free Animal Pack, poly.pizza generic 'Animated + Rigged' people: not verified as per-file CC0 with a real clip list within the time budget; skipped rather than trusting marketing copy.
